verdict_text:
YES

The script removes every tensor of blocks 2, 6, 10, 14, renumbers the survivors in original order to 0..11 while preserving the rest of each name and all values, passes the 4 non-block tensors through unchanged, and asserts before writing that the surviving block index set is exactly {0..11} (which rules out any block 12–15 and guarantees exactly 12 blocks) and that the output has exactly 184 tensors. Both assertions precede the directory creation and `save_file`, so a failure exits non-zero with no output written, satisfying the required checks.
